---
title: Renda i semblança entre seccions veïnes
lang: ca
ref: figura-renda-moran
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/autocorrelacio-exemples.json, context/inputs/seccions-tarragones.geojson]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/renda-moran.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.path import Path as MPath
from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch
from matplotlib.colors import BoundaryNorm, ListedColormap
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/autocorrelacio-exemples.json').read_text())
features=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/seccions-tarragones.geojson').read_text())['features']
rows=d['local']['renda-queen'];bycode={r['key']:r for r in rows}
positions={s['key']:s['label_xy'] for s in d['sections']}
result=next(r for r in d['trials'] if r['id']=='renda-queen')
cases={'4314807013':'Tarragona\n07013','4314808012':'Tarragona\n08012','4304701002':'Constantí\n01002'}
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':18,'svg.fonttype':'none','svg.hashsalt':'renda-moran'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,5.8),layout='constrained')
colours=['#fff0ba','#f8cf6b','#ec9853','#cd5a41','#8d2040']
cmap=ListedColormap(colours);norm=BoundaryNorm([7000,11000,15000,19000,23000,28000],len(colours))
for f in features:
    key=f['properties']['cusec'];geometry=f['geometry']
    parts=geometry['coordinates'] if geometry['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [geometry['coordinates']]
    for part in parts:
        vertices=[];codes=[]
        for ring in part:
            vertices.extend(np.asarray(ring)/1000)
            codes.extend([MPath.MOVETO]+[MPath.LINETO]*(len(ring)-2)+[MPath.CLOSEPOLY])
        axes[0].add_patch(PathPatch(MPath(vertices,codes),facecolor=cmap(norm(bycode[key]['value'])),edgecolor='white',lw=.45))
    if key in cases:
        xy=np.array(positions[key])/1000
        offsets={'4314807013':(8,12),'4314808012':(13,-35),'4304701002':(-48,12)}
        axes[0].annotate(cases[key],xy,xytext=offsets[key],textcoords='offset points',fontsize=16,
            bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'#314c5b','boxstyle':'round,pad=.15'},arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#314c5b'})
axes[0].autoscale_view();axes[0].set(aspect='equal',xticks=[],yticks=[],title='Renda publicada · 151 seccions')
for spine in axes[0].spines.values():spine.set_visible(False)
axes[0].plot([362,367],[4548,4548],color='#223644',lw=3)
axes[0].text(364.5,4547.5,'5 km',ha='center',va='top',fontsize=16)
bar=fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm=norm,cmap=cmap),ax=axes[0],orientation='horizontal',fraction=.065,pad=.035,
                ticks=[7000,11000,15000,19000,23000,28000])
bar.ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v,_:f'{v/1000:g}'))
bar.set_label('Milers d’euros nets per persona · 2023',fontsize=17)
x=np.array([r['value'] for r in rows]);lag=np.array([r['lag'] for r in rows]);ax=axes[1];mean=x.mean()
ax.scatter(x,lag,s=28,color='#4287a8',alpha=.8)
limits=np.array([6000,29000]);ax.plot(limits,mean+result['I']*(limits-mean),color='#b52e45',lw=2)
ax.axhline(mean,color='#89949a',lw=.8);ax.axvline(mean,color='#89949a',lw=.8)
for key,name in cases.items():
    r=bycode[key];ax.scatter(r['value'],r['lag'],s=90,color='#173b50',edgecolors='white',zorder=4)
    offset=(7,10) if key=='4314807013' else (12,-32) if key=='4314808012' else (-42,10)
    ax.annotate(name,(r['value'],r['lag']),xytext=offset,textcoords='offset points',fontsize=16,
                bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.8})
ax.set(xlim=limits,ylim=(6000,29000),xlabel='Renda de la secció\n(€/persona)',
       ylabel='Mitjana de les veïnes\n(€/persona)',title='Valor propi i entorn · I = 0,572')
ax.set_xticks([10000,20000,28000]);ax.set_yticks([10000,20000,28000])
formatter=FuncFormatter(lambda v,_:f'{v:,.0f}'.replace(',','.'))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter);ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)
for px,py,label in [(.04,.93,'Baix–alt'),(.72,.93,'Alt–alt'),(.04,.02,'Baix–baix'),(.72,.02,'Alt–baix')]:
    ax.text(px,py,label,transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=16,color='#5c6870')
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/renda-moran.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
